verdicts.reason: A breaks the signature device: the white frame floats empty over the knuckles at the top while the headline sits well below it outside the frame, and the underline dash has drifted to the very bottom edge, so the lockup is scattered into three disconnected fragments. B keeps the frame, headline and dash grouped as in the original and places them over the darker lower area, but the lockup is small for a 160px skyscraper, the frame is pushed toward the left edge with the text crammed against its right side, and the crop loses the chalked open hand that made the original image read.
